blockers.counterexample: M=N=(Z,<,P_everywhere) with envs [2,0] vs [1,0]. Same depth-(K+2) 1-var NFs (translation symmetry + uniform predicates). Matching orders (0<2 and 0<1). Z satisfies Prior-UZ/SZ (upper sets well-ordered). But depth-(K+2) 2-var NFs differ at K=0: zone (0,2) has integer w=1 satisfying any 3-var atomic pattern requiring 0<w<2, while zone (0,1) has no integer satisfying 0<w<1.
blockers.root_cause: 1-var NF agreement + matching orders does NOT determine 2-var NFs on non-constant environments, even on Prior structures. The between-zone content (what NF types exist strictly between the two reference points) is not captured by individual 1-var NFs.
blockers.impact: KampBypass.lean k>0 backward proofs (lines 532, 577) are unsound

blockers.description: Until/Since zone formulas encode only 1-var NF types (char_kp1(nf_t0) AND char_kp1(nf_x0) U top). This is insufficient to recover 2-var NF agreement. The eq zone formula (lines 596-627) correctly encodes quantifier conditions via quant_conj using ih_exist on constant parents. The Until/Since zones need analogous quantifier encoding but ih_exist only supports constant parents.
resolution_options: Option A: Extend Until/Since formula to include zone-specific quantifier conditions, encoding between-zone content. Requires adapting ih_exist to non-constant parents or reducing non-constant existentials to constant ones.
Option B: Generalize k=0 VecEA2 zone-bracket approach to k>0. Each zone bracket encodes its content using temporal formulas built from ih_exist.
Option C: Add a non-constant-parent ExistPart variant to the mutual induction.
